'''Osmani''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Part of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector's]] [[Osmani system/Legends|Osmani system]], is a minor trade world owing to its location in [[the Tangles]].<ref name="TEA" />
